solver_validation.interpretation: Development solver validation only. Readiness does not establish superiority, statistical significance, held-out quality or agent token savings.

payload_accounting: Session-event payloads include orientation and serialized responses. Native content counts include all actual MCP text replies, including refusals. Request params are counted separately using canonical JSON. These are cl100k diagnostics, not provider usage; overlapping response measures must not be added. Full raw payloads are retained.
timing: Pairs shuffled by frozen seed, then all three competitors sequentially in shuffled order within each task/repetition. Isolated workspaces/indexes; shared warm OS/dependency caches, including offline reference controls. Uncontrolled provider cache hits counted as input and separately logged. Wall includes orientation/index work, CLI startup, tools and final verification; excludes workspace preparation. Native CLI may write query stamps in each isolated graph directory; include this bookkeeping in wall time. No concurrent competitor executions.
interpretation: Three exposed development task units, two repetitions each. Report every failed/missing case and severe quality loss. No significance, held-out promotion or agent token-saving claim. Never pool earlier protocols. Corrected native CLI comparator and mandatory captured discovery are a separate configuration; do not pool earlier batches or infer causality from historical differences.
stop_reason: Frozen observed batch-token threshold reached; missing trials retained, no resumption under this plan.
